name: Filebrowser Quantum
short_desc: Modern self-hosted file manager with indexed real-time search, multiple sources, OIDC/LDAP auth, and rich previews.
description: A modern self-hosted web-based file manager. Fork of the original Filebrowser with major upgrades: real-time indexed search as you type, multiple source directories with include/exclude rules, rich thumbnail previews (office docs, video, album art, 3D models), configurable sharing with permissions and expiry, OIDC/LDAP/JWT/proxy authentication, SQLite indexing, WebDAV support, API tokens with Swagger docs, and a beautiful responsive UI with dark mode.
author: gtsteffaniak
